name: KCD:MP Feudal Wars
author: lol1luv@users.noreply.github.com
description: KCD:MP dedicated server running the Feudal Wars game mode (houses, wars, treasury, economy, web UI, admin console). Full deployment: downloads the server build, .NET 10 runtime and provisions the game mode database.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -e
cd /mnt/server

# /tmp inside the container is a tiny tmpfs: keep temp files on disk
mkdir -p /mnt/server/tmp
export TMPDIR=/mnt/server/tmp
export TMP=/mnt/server/tmp
export TEMP=/mnt/server/tmp

# .NET 10 runtime (the app host is 10.0.x)
if [ ! -f /mnt/server/dotnet/dotnet ]; then
  echo "Installing .NET 10 runtime..."
  curl -sSLf https://dot.net/v1/dotnet-install.sh -o /mnt/server/tmp/dotnet-install.sh
  chmod +x /mnt/server/tmp/dotnet-install.sh
  /mnt/server/tmp/dotnet-install.sh --channel 10.0 --runtime dotnet --install-dir /mnt/server/dotnet
fi

# server files (from the repo's first commit, which ships the binaries)
if [ ! -f KcdMp.Server ]; then
  echo "Downloading server files..."
  curl -sSLf https://github.com/lol1luv/kcd-mp-feudalwars/archive/6449f75.tar.gz -o /mnt/server/tmp/src.tar.gz
  mkdir -p /mnt/server/tmp/src
  tar xzf /mnt/server/tmp/src.tar.gz -C /mnt/server/tmp/src
  SRC_DIR=$(find /mnt/server/tmp/src -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -type d | head -1)
  cp -rn "$SRC_DIR"/. /mnt/server/
  rm -rf /mnt/server/tmp/src
fi

# the current game mode from the repo head (server script + web ui)
echo "Updating the Feudal Wars game mode..."
curl -sSLf https://github.com/lol1luv/kcd-mp-feudalwars/archive/refs/heads/main.tar.gz -o /mnt/server/tmp/main.tar.gz
mkdir -p /mnt/server/tmp/main
tar xzf /mnt/server/tmp/main.tar.gz -C /mnt/server/tmp/main
MAIN_DIR=$(find /mnt/server/tmp/main -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -type d | head -1)
mkdir -p /mnt/server/gamemodes
cp -f "$MAIN_DIR/gamemodes/feudalwars.lua" /mnt/server/gamemodes/feudalwars.lua
cp -rf "$MAIN_DIR/gamemodes/feudalwars" /mnt/server/gamemodes/
rm -rf /mnt/server/tmp/main

# generate server.toml: the panel's allocated port plus the game mode's database
cat > /mnt/server/server.toml <<EOF
[server]
name = "${SERVER_NAME:-KCD:MP Feudal Wars}"
port = ${SERVER_PORT}
max_players = ${MAX_PLAYERS:-32}
password = "${SERVER_PASSWORD:-}"
level = "${LEVEL:-klaster}"

[gamemode]
script = "gamemodes/feudalwars.lua"
watch = false

[gamemode.database]
driver = "mysql"
host = "${DB_HOST:-}"
port = ${DB_PORT:-3306}
user = "${DB_USERNAME:-}"
password = "${DB_PASSWORD:-}"
database = "${DB_DATABASE:-}"

[commands]
builtin = true
EOF

# the entrypoint of the image runs the STARTUP command with eval; make the local
# .NET 10 runtime visible to the app host through the container's profile
cat > /mnt/server/.bash_profile <<EOF
export DOTNET_ROOT=/home/container/dotnet
export DOTNET_ROOT_X64=/home/container/dotnet
export PATH=\$PATH:/home/container/dotnet
EOF
chmod +x KcdMp.Server
rm -rf /mnt/server/tmp
echo 'Installation finished.'

variables.description: Name shown in the server browser.

variables.name: Level
variables.description: Map level: klaster, trosecko or kutnohorsko.
